title: AYNA NL dataset object list
description: eval/nl/objects/<app>.json: the repository objects of one app version that gold steps may target (#36). Copied from the app's real controls, never invented. Checked by eval/nl/check_pairs.py.

app.description: App code; equals the file name without .json.

appVersion.description: The version shown in the app's title bar, or the commit of the app's source when it shows none.

source.description: Where the objects come from (source file, UIA dump, test that checks the AutomationIds).

objects.description: Logical name -> object. Names follow the step schema's logicalName pattern.

automationId.description: The control's UIA AutomationId, exactly as the app exposes it.

controlType.description: UIA ControlType name; decides which keywords and checkpoint properties fit (guideline section 6.3).

description.description: Short Turkish description, as a tester would name the control; the visible English text in parentheses when the UI is English.

items.description: ComboBox or List only: the item texts exactly as shown. A Select value must be one of them.
